recipe.visualDefinition: A flat, vector-style cartoon portrait of a male figure centered against a salmon-pink background, flanked by stylized palm trees with orange flames. The foreground features a large pile of green currency and massive, bold white sans-serif typography that overlaps the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between symmetrical palm tree motifs
Large-scale typography layered over the mid-ground subject
Currency pile anchoring the bottom of the composition
Consistent thick black line weight across all illustrated elements
coreInvariants: Limited flat color palette without gradients
Stylized orange flames atop palm fronds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-up portrait, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive white typography in the center-foreground acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large white text, move up to the subject's face, then down to the currency pile, and finally out to the flaming palm trees.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid salmon-pink sky provides breathing room around the complex central and bottom elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Salmon-pink background and red jacket provide a warm base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White typography and white foam cup provide high-value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted green for currency and palm trunks; orange for flames.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, medium-saturation pastels contrasted with stark white and deep black outlines.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly squashed vertically to increase perceived weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy weight for maximum impact; no secondary typefaces.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and heavy weight.
Provides the necessary modern, clean, and thick presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat vector illustration of a man with short dreadlocks and a red jacket, holding a white cup. Place him against a salmon-pink background with stylized palm trees that have orange flames on top. Include a pile of green currency at the bottom. Use thick black outlines and flat colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, extra-bold white geometric sans-serif text across the middle of the image, ensuring it overlaps the subject's chest and the cup.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid salmon-pink?
Are the outlines thick and consistently black?
Is the text white and extremely bold?
Are there flames on the palm trees?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent line weight across all elements
Confirm the salmon-pink background is solid
Ensure the currency pile covers the bottom edge
recipe.reuseFormula: Flat Vector Portrait + Symmetrical Tropical Motifs + Heavy Geometric Typography + Solid Pastel Background
